comment: The interaction states a component can be in, closed. A role-archetype declares which are VALID for its role (`interaction-states:` in its frontmatter), a contract may add more, and chapter 4.2 must answer every valid one — what changes, or `nothing — <reason>`. An unanswered state is a lint finding, never a silent default: an unstyled pressed state is a decision somebody has to be able to see. `rest` is implicit — the unconditioned token slots are rest.
lint: a valid state with no chapter 4.2 row
a chapter 4.2 row naming a property with no chapter 4.1 slot for that state
a chapter 4.1 slot in a state chapter 4.2 does not list for that property
a property that changes in some state but has no rest (unconditioned) slot
a slot restricted to some values of a visual axis, with the remaining values unaddressed
